method_card.objective: Locate publications in the public arXiv catalogue using investigator-selected field queries.
method_card.mechanism: Supply {"schema":"gx.scholarly-request/1"} and parameter query, e.g. ti:"heat diffusion". Use search-snapshot.json and the original query to replay one frozen Atom response offline.
method_card.estimator: candidates.json contains titles, authors, abstracts, dates, versioned IDs, DOI and version-bound PDF links when available. search-snapshot.json preserves the complete raw API response and retrieval details.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public catalogue and original-source records; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source. Original materials retain their respective licences.
manifest.licence_basis: Public arXiv metadata and preprints under their respective distribution licences.
manifest.limitations: First ranked page of at most eight records. Missing fields, a valid empty feed and an unavailable upstream are distinct. A metadata hit supports discovery only.
